  3. Leadership and team

Experienced structurers lead every HAYKALAH mandate.

HAYKALAH is led by its founder and a partner with sovereign-finance experience, supported by a core team that covers investment banking, Sukuk, operations, research, technology, brand and business development. Strategic partners extend that capacity on specific mandates.

Leadership

Hisham Koshak

Founder & CEO

  • Founded HAYKALAH in 2004.
  • Former Head of the Islamic Product Development Group, National Commercial Bank (NCB).
  • Senior structurer, Swicorp: infrastructure and real estate.
  • Board member (personal capacity), a land-development real estate fund in Qassim (2024).
  • MBA, Finance.

Over 25 years of experience across Islamic banking, product innovation and venture development. At NCB he founded the Islamic Product Development Group and led the development of the Kingdom’s first Islamic credit card and first Islamic cash financing, Tawarruq solutions and real estate-backed Islamic securitization funds. He oversees HAYKALAH’s multi-jurisdictional capital-structuring practice, venture strategy and high-value mandates.

Ayman Sejiny

Partner

  • Former CEO, Islamic Corporation for the Development of the Private Sector (ICD), Islamic Development Bank Group.
  • Former CEO, Ibdar Bank.
  • 25+ years in Islamic and sovereign capital strategy.

More than two decades structuring multi-jurisdictional programs that have mobilized over USD 1 billion across Asia, Africa and the Middle East. Specializes in sovereign and blended finance, public-private investment, and Islamic and ESG capital aligned with Vision 2030. He maintains strategic relationships with the Public Investment Fund (PIF), the Saudi Fund for Development (SFD), the World Bank Group, the Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) and the International Finance Corporation (IFC).
